_about: Save system data (task M3-9). slots: manual slots (1..N); the auto-save has its own file. new_game: where a fresh run starts (room id and spawn name; the scene router's rooms.json owns the real ids later). lamp_check: the beats Red goes through at a save spot before the save screen opens: light (the lamp glows up over 's' seconds), tap (a pulse on the glass), thumbs_up (Red's gesture pop-up, ends on a press). 'full' plays the first time each session, 'short' after that; one press skips either. sfx values are UI sound keys from ui_theme.json. Whether a lamp also heals the party is the lamp's own 'rest' setting (Red's home yes, dungeon lamps no).
